T: An adventure too big for the real world.
D: In 2045 a kid from the Stacks races, dances and plays his way through three of James Halliday's challenges to win the OASIS before a corporation does.
P: Serve the curry when Art3mis asks Kira to dance at the Overlook.
S: Wade was born after the corn syrup droughts
Heat the oil in a large lidded pot, add the corn, cover and shake until the popping stops. Melt the butter with the honey until bubbling. Toss through the popcorn with the salt.
Crisp wings in buffalo sauce with blue cheese. Parzival wins the race in reverse.

Pat the wings dry, toss with the baking powder and salt and lay on a rack over a tray. Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and mayo. Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through, then serve with celery and dip.
1kg chicken wings, tips off and halved@Meat
M: Green chicken curry in coconut milk. Art3mis dances with Kira for the Jade Key.

Fry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk until fragrant. Add the chicken and stir until coated, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk. Simmer with the beans and zucchini until the chicken is cooked. Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime and stir through the basil. Serve with the jasmine rice.
Cheeseburger with fries. Sixers get numbers, not names.

Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and mustard into a burger sauce. Roll the mince into 8 balls, smash thin on a hot griddle with onion and cook 2 minutes a side, cheese on top. Toast the buns and stack two patties each with pickles and sauce.
W: A filled chocolate egg, glossy and gold. Wade finds Halliday's Easter egg.

Melt two thirds of the chocolate, take off the heat and stir in the rest until glossy. Brush into 8 half-egg moulds in two coats and chill until set. Cook the sugar to deep amber, whisk in the cream, butter and salt and cool. Unmould, fill the halves with ice cream and caramel, join and brush with gold dust.
K: Cherry cola over ice cream. The Curator's coin is an extra life.
Put two scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Pour the cola slowly down the side and top with cherries.
